*Last updated: 23 November 2026*

## Who is responsible

The controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is Pietro Sala, Breisacher
Straße 17, 81667 München, Germany, mithrilmetrics@gmail.com. See the [legal notice](impressum.qmd).

## In short

This site has no user accounts, no cookies, no analytics and no advertising. We do not collect
names or email addresses. The only personal data processed when you visit is your network (IP)
address and basic browser information, which the services below need to deliver the pages.

## Hosting: GitHub Pages

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San
Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you open a page, GitHub processes your IP address, the page
requested, the time, and your browser and operating system, to deliver the page and keep the
service secure. GitHub may log this information. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in
publishing the site (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). This involves a transfer to the USA. GitHub is certified
under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and otherwise relies on the EU standard contractual
clauses. Details: GitHub's privacy statement,
https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement

## Fonts and formulas

Fonts are served from this site, and formulas are drawn by your browser. No font, script or
formula service is contacted when you open a case study.

## Reader questions page

On the Questions page you can vote for questions and
suggest new ones. The page loads the Turnstile script from Cloudflare and uses services of Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco,
CA 94107, USA:

- **Spam check (Cloudflare Turnstile):** checks your IP address and browser signals to tell people
  from automated programs.
- **Question service (Cloudflare Workers and D1):** stores the text and region of a suggested
  question and the number of votes per question. To refuse repeated votes, it stores for each vote
  a code computed from your IP address, the question and a secret key; the code cannot be turned
  back into the address and is deleted after 30 days. For daily limits on votes and questions it
  keeps a similar code per day, deleted after 2 days. Your IP address itself is not stored.

Please do not include personal details in a question. We review every question before it is
shown, may reword it, and publish only our wording. Questions we do not list are deleted at the
latest 30 days after triage, and questions never triaged after 60 days. Listed questions leave the
page at the latest 90 days after listing and are deleted 30 days later; for questions we take up,
we keep only our wording and the link to the answer. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in
running the page and protecting it from abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cloudflare is certified under
the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. Details: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

## Cookies and local storage

This site sets no cookies and uses no tracking. Only the following is stored in your browser:

- **Questions page, after you vote:** which questions you have voted for, so the page shows
  them as voted and does not send the same vote twice (local storage, until you clear it).
- **Questions page, spam check:** Cloudflare Turnstile may store a short-lived entry needed to
  tell people from automated programs. It is used only for this check.

Both are strictly necessary for functions you use on that page (§ 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG), so no
consent banner is needed. Other pages store nothing.

## Links to other sites

Posts link to LinkedIn, GitHub and the sources we use. These sites are only contacted when you
follow a link; their own privacy policies apply.

## Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data
portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 15–21 GDPR). As we
store no names or contact details, we usually cannot link data to you; write to us at the address
above if you have a request. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory
authority, for example the Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA), Promenade 18,
91522 Ansbach, Germany.
